objective: Receive optional Ledgerly rejection reasons through the actual public bridge.handle_json boundary.
cases: With at least two actual pending actions, a supplied stale/nonexistent identity cannot reject a different action or write the supplied literal reason to another action.

Reject the selected pending action with a nonblank reason containing literal whitespace, quotes, line breaks and Unicode. The returned reason and existing Agent event/audit must contain that same string; the other action remains pending and keeps its own identity.
Replaying that already-rejected identity with a different reason must refuse without replacing its original audit/reason or consuming another pending action.
Reject the remaining action through the backward-compatible omitted-reason request and retain its documented default without carrying the earlier action's reason.
whitespaceContract: Missing, empty or Python str.strip-empty reason uses default. Nonblank exact text retained. Non-string or more than500 Python Unicode code points rejected before Agent.reject.
execution: Python3.14 public bridge.handle_json(JSON) with actual Demo/Agent/SandboxMock, separate fresh import/process per original/candidate. No core, provider, browser or source mutations; no broad suite.
declaredLimits: Not a full UI receipt or hosted/release integration gate. Every source pin and actual effect observation is retained.
